unity_particle_recommendation.renderer: Billboard, additive 或 premultiplied alpha，關閉陰影與光照
unity_particle_recommendation.motion: 低速上浮、平緩水平雜訊；高度約水面上 0.2–1.8 m
unity_particle_recommendation.colorOverLifetime: 暖黃淡入、峰值約 0.45 秒、末段淡出
unity_particle_recommendation.useCondition: 夜晚溪邊與 D5 蕈谷；白天停用
unity_particle_recommendation.performance: 需於 Unity 實測後調整數量與 overdraw
